strongest_suspected_weakness: TimelineMaterializer.rebuild() computes rebuild_receipt_id from build_postgres_projection() outside the advisory-locked transaction block, but materialize() calls assemble_timeline() inside the transaction. Advisory lock serializes access across callers, and both calls target the same immutable service, but theoretically the service could return different data between the two calls. ON CONFLICT safety net on rebuild_receipts prevents data corruption if receipt ID mismatches actual data. Root fix would move receipt ID computation inside the locked transaction.
